errors.error_description: Used case-equality (===) for the active-low reset check in an always_ff block, which is non-synthesizable and a dangerous operator misuse.
Declared and used an escaped identifier named after a reserved keyword (always_comb) as a logic signal.
Instantiated a gate primitive (buf) with port width mismatch by connecting an 8-bit source to a 4-bit destination.
Introduced a deeply nested if-else chain in combinational logic that creates long combinational paths and poor synthesis quality.
